values.value: Where does subscription and consent state live — HubSpot subscription types, GDPR fields, or somewhere outside the platform entirely?

[{"value":1,"label":"Consent is HubSpot subscription types plus list membership, with no record of when or how it was given."},{"value":2,"label":"Subscription types are used properly and lawful basis is recorded, but only inside HubSpot."},{"value":3,"label":"Consent state is held or mirrored outside HubSpot, with provenance, and could be re-established on a new platform."},{"value":4,"label":"Consent is already a cross-channel policy on the target platform, verified against current behaviour."}]

MCN Consent & Custom Preferences is a Spring '26+ capability and its parity with a live preference centre is unverified. Nobody can score a 4 on this pair today, because the thing a 4 describes cannot yet be confirmed to exist — which is also why the consent workstream comes off the critical path rather than onto it.
